description: The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) intends to negotiate a one-time, sole source, firm fixed price contract with REMOTEC, Inc, Address: 353 JD Yarnell Industrial Parkway Clinton, TN 37716 for the purpose of procuring replacement parts for REMOTEC Robots, model F6B and the Spartan. The FBI possesses robots manufactured by REMOTEC, Inc. Due to normal usage and wear and tear these parts are required to be replaced. The robots and their parts are proprietary information to REMOTEC, Inc., and they are the only manufacturers and distributors of these parts.
